item.description:

Domocile (DOMO) is a 4-piece electronic-infused instrumental jam band formed in Wilmington, NC in 2023 (Chase Farnitano – Guitar/Ableton, Wolf Lampke – Synth, Brandon Bales – Bass, Will Walter – Drums). Inspired by acts such as STS9, The New Deal, and Papadosio, DOMO combines dark, funky guitar riffs, space-driven synth and EDM-inspired vocal samples with a dynamic rhythm section to create a unique soundscape that is equal parts dancy and atmospheric. ​DOMO relies heavily on live improv and takes pride in ensuring each set is its own uniquely curated performance. This attention to detail has garnered them a local reputation as a can’t-miss live show and landed them opening slots with premier jamtronica acts such as Papadosio and Dizgo. ​

item.description:
Senior Singles Fun Bunch **Let’s go to the zoo! And late September is a good month to do so for the weather isn’t so hot, kids are back in school, most tourists are gone, etc. so it won’t be so crowded ~ hopefully!**
**The Greenville Zoo is located on 14 acres. The total walking distance is exactly one mile of a paved loop that gives you the opportunity to see every animal exhibit.**
**There are plenty of mature trees that provide shade and multiple benches to sit. And if you need a snack there is a concession stand. And, of course, restrooms.**

item.description:
Fall Wildflowers of the NC Arboretum with Lauren Lampley Saturday, October 10 | 1 – 4pm BRN and BREG – Core Register Here!
Interested in learning how to identify wildflowers? Join Lauren on this walk around the Arboretum property where we will go over different ways of identifying plants and different families of flowers. Some flowers are very difficult to identify to species and some are relatively easy so we will talk about how to get as close as possible with tools we can easily carry into the field. We will be using Newcomb’s guide to key out some of the less common flowers but will focus on learning how to look closely at flowers to identify them. This program will take place outside and will follow easy trails and paved walkways. Dress for the weather and prepare to be outside for the entire program time. item.description:
"They make a classic bluegrass sound that's not afraid to go somewhere new." —Appalachian Jamwich
Born from the tradition of bluegrass jams & potlucks, THE PLATE SCRAPERS — Derek Kretzer (banjo), Andrew Jordan (guitar), Robbie Mann (fiddle), Jody Mosser (dobro), and Kevin Johnson (bass) — have been putting in the work and showcasing their love for the genre since 2014. They’ve since released 3 studio albums, 3 live albums, and have toured relentlessly up and down the east coast and into the midwest.
In 2019, they won the Podunk Bluegrass Telefunken Band Contest. They have been featured on WAMU Bluegrass Country Radio, performed as an IBMA Official Showcase artist, and their latest release, "Destination Horizon" (2020) debuted at #9 on the Bluegrass Album Billboard charts with rave reviews from Bluegrass Today.
